## What is this?

This is a **lightweight fork** of [end-4/dots-hyprland](https://github.com/end-4/dots-hyprland) with the following components removed:

- ❌ **AI Chat** - Sidebar AI assistant (Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama integrations)
- ❌ **Anime/Booru** - Anime wallpaper browser and downloader
- ❌ **Translator** - translate-shell integration

Everything else from the original dotfiles remains intact.

## Why?

Some users prefer a cleaner installation without these features, whether for:

- Reduced complexity
- Privacy concerns
- Smaller footprint
- Personal preference

## Installation

Same as the original:

```bash
bash <(curl -s https://ii.clsty.link/get)
```

Or clone this repo and run `./setup install`

## Applying to existing installation

If you already have the original dots-hyprland installed and want to remove these components:

```bash
./remove-ai-anime-translator.sh
```

## Upstream

For the full-featured version with AI, Anime, and Translator, see the original repository:

- **Repository**: [end-4/dots-hyprland](https://github.com/end-4/dots-hyprland)
